title: Triggers & Hitboxes
description: Detect non-blocking area overlaps, collect items, and activate frame-accurate melee combat hitboxes.

blocks.content: Triggers and hitboxes detect non-blocking overlaps for area checkpoints, collectible pickups, and melee or projectile combat.

items.title: Event-Driven Trigger Zones
items.desc: Fire entry, exit, and continuous presence events whenever an entity matching a target tag crosses a sensor boundary.

items.title: Collectible Pickups
items.desc: Handle touch or key-prompt item collection with automatic bobbing, sound effects, score values, and timed respawns.

items.title: Frame-Synced Combat Hitboxes
items.desc: Activate attack hitboxes during specific animation frames, chain multi-hit combos, and apply directional knockback.

blocks.content: Attach the following components and prepare the required nodes before building trigger zones, pickups, or combat hitboxes.

rows: Defines the overlap volume with **Is Sensor** enabled so entities pass through without physical blocking.
Registers actors and sensor zones in the physics simulation and receives knockback impulses during combat.
Plays idle, pickup, and multi-stage attack clips synchronized with hitbox activation frames.

blocks.content: Follow these steps to configure a non-blocking sensor zone and an animated melee combat hitbox.

items: In the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy), select the checkpoint or pickup entity, attach [Physics Body](components/physics_body) (**Static** body) and [Multi Collider](components/multi_collider), and enable **Is Sensor** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector).
Select the player entity and set its **Tag** field in the Property Inspector header to **player** so sensor nodes can filter overlaps.

Open the sensor entity's [Logic Graph](visual_scripting/graph_concepts) and wire [On Tick](node_library/game_lifecycle#node-eventTick) into [Trigger Zone](node_library/game_physics#node-triggerZone) with **Target Tag** set to **player**.
Connect the **On Enter** execution output of **Trigger Zone** to your checkpoint save, dialogue trigger, or hazard damage logic.

For item pickups, replace **Trigger Zone** with [Collectable Item](node_library/helper_tool#node-collectableItem), set **Collector Tag** to **player**, and connect **On Collected** to update your score variable.
For melee attacks, open the player graph, add [Platformer Combat](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerCombat), and set **Target Tag** to **enemy** and **Attack Key** to **j**.
Connect **On Hit** from **Platformer Combat** to [Apply Knockback](node_library/game_physics#node-applyKnockback), passing **Hit Target** as the target entity so struck enemies recoil from the blow.

blocks.content: Tune these parameters on [Trigger Zone](node_library/game_physics#node-triggerZone), [Collectable Item](node_library/helper_tool#node-collectableItem), and [Platformer Combat](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerCombat) to control overlap detection and combat timing.

rows: Filters overlap checks so only entities with the matching tag activate the trigger, pickup, or hitbox.
Collects the item immediately on touch when set to **collision**, or waits for **Interact Key** (**e**) when set to **interact_key**.
Determines whether a collected pickup destroys itself permanently, deactivates for **Respawn Time** seconds, or stays active.
Applies a smooth vertical sine wave and gentle rotation to the pickup sprite while idle.
Defines each combo stage's animation clip, damage value, hitbox offset (**offsetX**, **offsetY**), size (**width**, **height**), and active frame window.
Time window in seconds after an attack finishes before the combo counter resets to the first strike.
Minimum delay in seconds after a combo ends before the actor can initiate a new attack sequence.

blocks.content: Adapt trigger zones and hitboxes for interactive chests, enemy AI attacks, and dynamic collider toggling.

rows: In [Collectable Item](node_library/helper_tool#node-collectableItem), set **Pickup Mode** to **interact_key**, **Interact Key** to **e**, and **Despawn Action** to **none** so pressing **E** plays the chest opening animation.
Wire [Enemy Combat](node_library/helper_tool#node-enemyCombat) onto an enemy entity to detect the player within an aggro radius, trigger attack clips, and spawn synchronized damage hitboxes.
Call [Manage Collider](node_library/game_physics#node-manageCollider) to resize, offset, or disable an entity's hitbox when crouching, sliding, or entering invulnerability frames.

Trigger [Shake Transform](node_library/game_animation#node-actionShakeTransform) from the **On Hit** output of [Platformer Combat](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerCombat) to add tactile impact feedback on each strike.
Player bounces off the trigger zone or coin instead of passing through it
Select the trigger or coin entity and enable **Is Sensor** on its [Multi Collider](components/multi_collider) component so it detects overlaps without solid blocking.
Verify that the entering entity's **Tag** in the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector) matches **Target Tag** (case-insensitive) and that both entities have active colliders.
[Platformer Combat](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerCombat) plays the animation but deals no damage
Check that target enemies carry the exact tag specified in **Target Tag** (**enemy**) and that **startFrame** and **endFrame** in **Attacks Config** fall within the clip's frame count.
Attack hitbox spawns on the wrong side when the player turns around
Wire the **Facing Direction** output from [Platformer Controller](node_library/helper_tool#node-platformerController) into the **Facing Direction** input of **Platformer Combat**.
Configure solid collisions, sloped terrain, and one-way platforms.
Connect horizontal facing direction and grounded state into combat nodes.
Inspect sensor toggles, collision layers, and shape bounds.
Look up all ports for Collectable Item, Platformer Combat, and Enemy Combat.
